Good Afternoon,

 

HTA Group Limited is a sheet metal Laser Cutting and Fabrication company and are based at our 90,000 sq ft factory in Coventry.

 

Our Main areas of expertise are

 

Laser Cutting up to 4m – Our new 24kw Trumpf Laser is now up and running to complement our 12kw machine. Using this latest technology means we are very competitive in this market.

CNC Punching.

CNC Folding up to 4m – Five machines up to 230 ton with a 4m bed size.

Manual & Robotic Welding over 20 bays.

Powder Coating with our 4 stage pre-treatment on line system

Tapping

Fastener Insertion

Projection Welding

Many other ancillary operations are also available.

 

Our Production Weld Shop specialises in small to medium size fabrications although our Prototype Weld Shop can cope with small volume larger fabrications.

 

Our quality is approved to ISO 9001, EN 15085 and BS/EN 1090.

 

If this is of interest to you we would very much appreciate the chance to quote on any enquiries you may have. We quote any batch size including scheduled OEM business and will work with you on lead times.

 

Please send any enquiries to myself at geoff.lockton@htagroup.co.uk or contact me on 07970983475

 

More details can be found at www.htagroup.co.uk and our 2026 Company Overview attached.

 

GDPR Statement. We operate a no spam policy. If you do not wish to receive further communications from me , please let me know and I will remove you from our database.

 

Best Regards,

 

Geoff Lockton
